# UiField

Label, hint and error wiring for any control; the layout primitive every input is built on.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | inputs |
| Import | `import { UiField } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import UiField from '@your-scope/ui/components/UiField'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/inputs/UiField.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/inputs/UiField.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  | Label text. It is the accessible name of the control. |
| `hint` | `string` |  | Helper text, associated with the control through `aria-describedby`. |
| `error` | `string \| readonly string[] \| null` |  | Error message(s). A non-empty value also marks the field invalid. |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Marks the field as required: the native `required` attribute plus a decorative marker on the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables the control, with the native `disabled` attribute where the element has one. |
| `invalid` | `boolean` | `false` | Mark invalid without showing a message. |
| `size` | `UiSize` |  | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `UiProvider` `defaults`, then to `ui.config.ts`. |
| `id` | `string` |  | Id for the control. Generated (and stable) when omitted. |
| `as` | `'div' \| 'fieldset'` | `'div'` | `fieldset` renders a `<fieldset>` with a `<legend>` for groups of controls. |
| `hideLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Keep the label for assistive technology but hide it visually. |
| `orientation` | `'vertical' \| 'horizontal'` | `'vertical'` | `horizontal` places the label beside the control when the container is wide enough. |

## Slots

| Slot | Slot props | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `default` | `props: UiFieldSlotProps` | The control. Bind `id`, `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` from the slot props. |
| `label` |  |  |
| `hint` |  |  |
| `error` | `props: { messages: readonly string[] }` |  |

## Attributes

The root element (`<div>` or `<fieldset>`).

## Accessibility

- The label points at the control (`for`/`id`); hint and error ids are exposed for `aria-describedby`.
- `as="fieldset"` renders `<fieldset>`/`<legend>` for groups.
- Errors pair colour with an icon and text; the required marker is decorative because the control carries `required`.

## Styling

- `.vui-field`, `.vui-field__label`, `.vui-field__hint`, `.vui-field__error`
- `data-size`, `data-orientation`, `data-invalid`, `data-disabled`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/InputsDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<UiField :label="t('demo.field.custom')" :hint="t('demo.field.hint')" class="max-w-sm">
  <template #default="{ id, describedBy }">
    <input
      :id="id"
      v-model="custom"
      :aria-describedby="describedBy"
      class="w-full rounded-vui border border-vui-border-strong bg-vui-surface px-2.5 py-1.5 text-vui-md"
    />
  </template>
</UiField>
```
